title: IM Controller
text: Internal torque-based, field-oriented controller for an induction motor with an optional outer-loop speed controller, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Parameterize losses by} sets Select type Single efficiency; {Control Type} selects control Speed, {Stator resistance, Rs} sets the resistance, {Stator leakage inductance, Lls} sets the inductance, {Rotor resistance, Rr} sets the resistance, {Rotor leakage inductance, Llr} sets the inductance, {Rotor magnetizing inductance, Lm} sets the inductance, {Number of pole pairs, PolePairs} sets the poles, {Physical inertia, viscous damping, static friction, Mechanical} sets the mechanical properties of motor, {Rated synchronous speed, Frate} sets the motor frequency, {Rated line to line voltage RMS, Vrate} sets the motor voltage, {Rated slip, Srate} sets the motor slip speed, {Calculate Rated Stator Flux Current} sets the derive parameters, {D-axis rated current, Isd_0} sets the derived, {Q-axis rated current, Isq_0} sets the derived, {Torque at rated current, Tem} sets the derived, {Bandwidth of the current regulator, EV_current}, {Sample time for the torque control, Tst} sets the time 5e-5, {Calculate Current Regulator Gains} sets the derive parameters, {D and Q axis proportional gain, Kp} sets the derived, {D and Q axis integral gain, Ki} sets the derived, {Bandwidth of the motion controller, EV_motion} sets the bandwidth, {Bandwidth of the state filter, EV_sf}, {Calculate Speed Regulator Gains} sets the derive parameters, {Proportional gain, ba} sets the derived, {Angular gain, Ksa} sets the derived, {Rotational gain, Kisa} sets the derived, {Speed regulation time constant, Ksf} sets the derived, {Inertia compensation, Jcomp} sets the derived, {Viscous damping compensation, Fv} sets the derived, {Static friction, Fs} sets the derived, {Overall inverter efficiency, eff} sets the constant, {Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated loss, w_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of torques (T) for tabulated loss, T_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Corresponding losses, losses_table} sets the table, {Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated efficiency, w_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of torques (T) for tabulated efficiency, T_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints and {Corresponding efficiency, efficiency_table} sets the table. Values come from the instance.
